title: Ursa Major & Minor | Unique 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Ursa Major and Ursa Minor is a pet-friendly WaterColor retreat with a watchtower, bikes, dual living spaces, and Beach Club access steps from shops.
description_expanded: Ursa Major and Ursa Minor Features - Highly sought after location on Buttercup Street - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee/per pet is required prior to your arrival. - Flexible arrival days all year round! - 1 Min Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club - 1 Block to Cerulean Park - 1 Block to shopping and dining, including Wine World and Scratch Biscuit Kitchen - Access to 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your adventures - Access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and community pools for up to 10 guests age 5 and under included with your reservation. Community pools are heated during cooler months and provide towel service (subject to change by the HOA). - Parking for 4 vehicles, including covered parking for 2 vehicles - Wrap-around porch with outdoor dining, lounge chairs, and seating set overlooking Buttercup Street - Top floor watchtower with 360 degree view of WaterColor and a telescope for night sky viewing - Exterior stairs connect the top and bottom floors (no interior stairs) - Opens to a pocket park - Separate Laundry Room with washer/dryer - 1st Floor Full Kitchen fully stocked for preparing family meals - 2nd Floor Large Kitchenette with mini fridge, oven, microwave, and dishwasher - Smart TVs in all bedrooms and both living rooms - Cable and WIFI Mid-century living with a twist! Perfect for a family who'd love to be under one roof while still having space that is just theirs, Ursa Major offers a 3-bedroom condo-style living space, while Ursa Minor (found just below in the same home) offers an amazing studio apartment with the main kitchen and living space large enough for everyone! The alabaster exterior shines on Buttercup Street like the North Star. Perfectly located in the highly sought after Phase 1 of Watercolor, the home sits on a peaceful pocket park and is 1 block to Cerulean Park. When you want to visit the beach, it's a quick 1min bike ride to the Beach Club! Access to newly renovated Beach Club is included in your stay. The Boat House pool is a 2min walk from the home when you want to enjoy a pool with views of Western Lake. Enter and exit Ursa Major or Ursa Minor without bothering anyone on other floors with private entry. Plan to settle in to study the night sky from the 3rd floor watchtower, which can be made totally dark for stargazing. Telescope available for enhanced experience! The 1st floor studio apartment, Ursa Minor, features huge kitchen, spacious living room, full bath, and plush queen-sized lofted bed with privacy divider. Tuck in for the night when you're ready or open the divider for the whole crew to gather! The main living space and kitchen are a perfect place for family meals + pondering the wonders of the universe. Above, Ursa Major boasts 3 king sized bedrooms with cozy and comfortable beds. 2 king bedrooms share a spacious full bath and the third, true primary California King suite has a private bath. Ursa Major guests can also enjoy their own large kitchenette and living space. This home has a unique European layout that offers the perfect space for a family vacation. If you are a book worm, beach comber, nature lover, star gazer or just want the best location and value in WaterColor, you have found your spot in this modern, artsy heaven. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor Queen Bedroom | semi-private with screen to block access from living room, hallway access to full bath with a walk-in shower
2nd Floor California King Suite | Smart TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Guest Room 1 | Smart TV, hallway access to shared full bath with combo shower/tub
2nd Floor King Guest Room 2 | Smart TV, hallway access to shared full bath with combo shower/tub
2nd Floor Queen Sleeper Sofa | located in the 2nd floor living room
Twin EZ Bed | Twin EZ Bed (elevated air mattress) can be used on either level of the home

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night

all: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
